The series shows moderate seasonality and unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean may outperform weighted or median by discarding outlier model forecasts.
Try a robust weighted combination using softmax of negative error to see if it beats trimmed mean on this noisy, medium predictability series.
The series has unstable ranking and several correlated groups; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture changing strengths across horizons.
Testing a simple mean on the stable 7‑model pool (pool4) to see if a reduced, robust subset beats the full‑pool weighted approach, given the unstable ranking and moderate seasonality.
Ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist, so a robust DBA over the full pool may better exploit complementary errors than simple weighting.
Test a forward‑selection weighted combination on the full pool to see if a sparse greedy mix beats the current DBA leader.
The series has unstable ranking and moderate seasonality; a robust weighted inverse-error on a smaller, more diverse pool (pool4) may outperform DBA.
The series has unstable ranking and moderate seasonality, so a per‑horizon weighted combination may capture horizon‑specific strengths.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w8' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9138. Series context: trend strength 0.0 and seasonal strength 0.5399; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.029); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.874.
